entity_types.name: NationState
entity_types.description: Sovereign state whose decisions causally shape the war trajectory and outcomes
entity_types.selection_rule: Any sovereign government (e.g., Russia, Ukraine, US, China) acting as a decision-maker in the conflict or its economic aftermath

attributes.name: war_role
attributes.description: Belligerent / key supporter / mediator / third party

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: High / medium / low influence on end-2027 war state

entity_types.name: InternationalOrganization
entity_types.description: Multilateral institution with collective decision leverage (EU, NATO, UN, IMF)
entity_types.selection_rule: Multilateral bodies whose collective decisions (aid, sanctions, enlargement, financing) affect the war outcome

entity_types.name: GovernmentBody
entity_types.description: Executive agency, ministry or regulator within a state (central banks, defense ministries, energy...
entity_types.selection_rule: Sub-state institutions with concrete policy levers (sanctions enforcement, oil-price-cap enforcement, monetary policy, arms procurement)
levers: enforce oil price cap and shadow-fleet sanctions
set interest rates and capital controls

entity_types.name: PoliticalLeader
entity_types.description: Individual decision-maker (presidents, prime ministers, senior negotiators) whose choices move th...
entity_types.selection_rule: Named individuals holding executive or negotiating authority over war, aid or sanctions decisions

attributes.name: office_held
attributes.description: Position / office (refer by office where sensitive)

examples: EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs

entity_types.name: MilitaryActor
entity_types.description: Armed forces or defense-industrial entities that determine battlefield attrition and strike tempo
entity_types.selection_rule: Armed services, defense ministries' combat arms, and major arms producers shaping military balance

attributes.name: capability_focus
attributes.description: Artillery / drones / missiles / air defense / manpower

entity_types.name: MarketAsset
entity_types.description: Trackable asset or price object the forecast's market implications attach to
entity_types.selection_rule: Specific tradeable assets or price benchmarks (Brent, TTF, gold, defense equity indices, CEE currencies, Ukrainian sovereign debt)

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Commodity / equity / FX / sovereign debt / safe haven

attributes.name: war_sensitivity
attributes.description: High / medium / low sensitivity to war-state shifts

entity_types.name: Territory
entity_types.description: Contested or controlled geographic object whose possession defines forecast territory-held outcomes
entity_types.selection_rule: Specific regions, oblasts or front-line sectors whose control status is tracked

entity_types.name: SanctionsRegime
entity_types.description: Concrete sanctions or export-control regime treated as an institutional object that evolves over ...
entity_types.selection_rule: Named sanctions packages, price caps, and export controls whose imposition/lifting is a verifiable outcome
examples: US export controls on advanced semiconductors to Russia

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Any individual person not fitting other specific person types.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Any organization not fitting other specific organization types.

edge_types.name: PROVIDES_MILITARY_AID_TO
edge_types.description: State or organization supplies weapons, funding or intelligence to a belligerent
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source supplies military aid to target belligerent

edge_types.name: IMPOSES_SANCTIONS_ON
edge_types.description: Actor imposes or enforces sanctions regime against a target state
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source imposes sanctions regime on target

edge_types.name: TARGETS
edge_types.description: Sanctions regime legally targets a state or its sectors
edge_types.direction_semantics: Sanctions regime targets the named state economy

edge_types.name: MEDIATES
edge_types.description: Third party mediates or guarantees a negotiation track
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source mediates the target negotiation track

edge_types.name: PARTICIPATES_IN
edge_types.description: Belligerent or party participates in a negotiation track
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source party is a participant in the target negotiation track

edge_types.name: CONTROLS
edge_types.description: Belligerent currently controls a territory object

edge_types.name: ALLIED_WITH
edge_types.description: Alignment or partnership between states and blocs
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source is allied with target (symmetric alignment)

edge_types.name: OPPOSES
edge_types.description: Adversarial posture or proxy opposition between actors
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source opposes target actor's war aims

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES_TO
edge_types.description: Material or dual-goods supply relationship sustaining a belligerent's war economy
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source supplies materials/components to target state

edge_types.name: CAUSES_PRICE_MOVE_IN
edge_types.description: Causal edge: war-state or regime shifts transmit into asset price moves
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source (war state, regime, scenario) causally drives target asset's price direction

analysis_summary: 该预测问题是一个地缘政治—宏观经济混合领域：核心是2027年末俄乌战争在五级连续谱上的状态定位，并外推能源价格、国防开支、制裁演化与金融市场反应。主体阵容以国家（俄、乌、美、中、欧盟核心国）、政府机构（财政部/央行/国防部）、国际组织（EU、NATO、IMF）、政治领导人及国防工业/军队为主，均为对战争结局有因果杠杆的能动主体；媒体与智库按 source 处理而不设能动类型。客体层包括可追踪市场资产（Brent、TTF、黄金、欧洲国防股、CEE货币、乌克兰主权债）、争议领土、制裁制度、谈判轨道与情景对象。关系覆盖军事援助、制裁（对抗性 + 因果约束 CAUSES/CONSTRAINS）、谈判参与/调解、领土控制、结盟/对抗、战争状态向资产价格的因果传导，全部携带 sign/lag/strength/sentiment 等可过滤属性，服务于多情景概率推演与二元预测。
